purpose: Every dependency advisory open against this repository, read by a person, tagged with its CWE and its OWASP category, and carrying the date somebody looks at it again. scripts/check-security.mjs fails on anything here that is missing, expired, or reachable at high or critical with no story named.

advisories.why: Node's HTTP client, transitive. The SOCKS5, shared-cache and WebSocket advisories each need a deployment feature this project does not run: there is no forward proxy, no shared response cache and no undici WebSocket client. The Set-Cookie and CRLF entries are the ones that would matter if outbound fetch ever carried user-controlled header content, which is why this reads unproven rather than no.
